basic_info.description: Spacious, well-preserved 1925 classic single family home in convenient location near shopping, schools and transportation. Many original details remain intact in this generous multi-entrance property. The main upper level boasts three bedrooms, living room with fireplace, formal dining room, large kitchen with stainless steel appliances, split bath, gleaming refinished hardwood floors and new lighting through-out. The lower level adds a fourth bedroom, family room, wet bar and well well appointed full bathroom.  The independently accessed lower level has incredible ADU potential. Large garage with internal access to both levels and laundry/workshop area. Ample rear yard/patio. Prime Excelsior location in close proximity to the Glen Park Tech bus depot, BART, MUNI and the 101/280 freeways. Walk to Mission street shops and steps to the Manila Oriental Market. Good proximity to McLaren Park hiking, pickle-ball, tennis, basketball and off-leash dog play area. Great property for extended family. Must see.
